capacity_source_title: Carnival Conquest - Carnival Cruise Line ship page
notes: 2002 Conquest-class lead ship, still sailing for Carnival under this name: listed in Carnival Corporation's fleet as of May 31, 2026 ('Carnival Conquest 2002 2,980'); Wikipedia status 'In service', no rename. carnival.com does not define the figure; Carnival Corporation's fleet report gives the same 2,980 as passenger capacity (lower berths per 10-K). IMO 9198355 also on VesselFinder/Gard/MaritimeOptima search results.

Official page also states 'Built: 2000', 'Last refurbishment: 2019', 'Crew capacity: 302' (crew not used). Search snippets from secondary sites (CruiseMapper, adventure-life 'Max Passengers: 388') show 388, likely the pre-2019-refit figure; not fetched, so not listed in other_values_seen. IMO: VesselFinder shows SILVER SHADOW, IMO 9192167, MMSI 308628000, built 2000; one secondary site (luxurycruiseconnections) lists 9176692, which conflicts and was not used.

capacity_source_title: The Ritz-Carlton Yacht Collection press release: Ilma, the newest superyacht ... makes its debut
quote: The purposefully designed yacht accommodates up to 448 guests
notes: Official press release (Fort Lauderdale, September 3, 2024) also says 'offering 224 airy and intuitive suites', so 448 = 2 per suite (effectively double occupancy), but the source words it as 'up to', so typed as maximum. The yacht page on ritzcarltonyachtcollection.com did not render for fetching. IMO: VesselFinder shows ILMA, IMO 9967586, MMSI 256343000, built 2024 (also CruiseMapper/CruiseDig per search).

Official page sentence describes Emerald Sakara (sister to Emerald Azzurra, launched 2023) as 'Hosting just 100 guests'. Search snippets (not fetched) from Baird Maritime say 100 passengers in 50 cabins, consistent with double occupancy. Emerald's own pages give conflicting crew counts (64 vs 76) - irrelevant to passengers. IMO: VesselFinder shows EMERALD SAKARA, IMO 9948827, MMSI 311001261, built 2023; secondary sites listing 9770000 or 9870881 conflict and were not used.
